description: How `parity.py diff` puts a diff on a backlog group (docs/rust-port/BACKLOG.md). Each request carries its group in the corpus ("backlog", default "base": behavior the Rust port had at 2026.10.04). These rules come first: a rule takes a whole differing aspect (status, body, header:<name>) when it has no "match", or the single diff lines its "match" regex finds. Whatever no rule takes falls to the request's own group. One request can count in several groups.
